notes:
- New short-form format: Studio Podcast. Captions appear a line at a time, written word by word as they are said, with the words that carry the point in your accent colour and a soft glow.
- A few big words per clip ripple in, slide up and stay on screen long enough to read, and two or three lines that matter get a stacked layout with three sizes of type. The picture punches in between sentences, and the show's own wide shots push in slowly.
- No title card, no B-roll, no call to action at the end and no name card. It uses your brand font, and your secondary colour when you have one (otherwise your accent).
